review_candidates.description: Almanya’da zihinsel performans ve uyku için bir gıda takviyesi markası kuruyoruz. Ürünümüz hazır, Almanya’da ekibimiz var. Şimdi bu markayı dijitalde büyütecek kişiyi arıyoruz. Neden Almanya’dan değil de Türkiye’den? Çünkü Türkiye’de dijital pazarlamayı daha hızlı, daha akıllı ve daha cesur yapan insanlar olduğuna inanıyoruz. Biz de bunu 4 yıldır her ay önemli reklam bütçesiyle yapıyoruz. Elimizde güçlü bir koz var: Markamızın yüzü, Almanca konuşan, kibar ve etkileyici bir doktor. Onunla düzenli video çekiyoruz. Almanya’da insanlar doktora güvenir; biz de bu güveni markaya dönüştürmek istiyoruz. Seninle yapmak istediklerimiz: Markayı sıfırdan konumlandırmak ve Almanya’da büyütmek Doktorumuzun videolarını Meta, TikTok ve YouTube’da satış getiren reklamlara dönüştürmek Almanya’daki rakipleri didik didik incelemek: hangi reklam kazanıyor, hangi mesaj işliyor, müşteriler neyi seviyor, neyden şikâyet ediyor? Önce iyi olanı öğrenip sonra daha iyisini yapmak Online mağazayı (Shopify), ürün sayfalarını ve satın alma deneyimini sürekli iyileştirmek Amazon.de ve influencer kanallarını açmak Almanca içerik, analiz ve iletişimi AI ile hızlı ve kaliteli yürütmek Seninle ilgili bilmek istediklerimiz: E-ticaret pazarlaması yaptın ve bir markayı veya hesabı sıfırdan büyüttün Meta ve TikTok reklamlarında güçlüsün, özellikle video kreatifle düşünüyorsun AI senin günlük çalışma aracın. Almancan yoksa sorun değil; AI ile Almanca içerik üretip yönetebilecek kadar AI’a hâkimsen yeterli İngilizcen iyi Bir markayı kendi markan gibi sahiplenebilirsin Amazon deneyimin varsa büyük artı Sana sunduklarımız: Bir markayı baştan kurma deneyimi; böyle bir fırsat kariyerde az gelir Uluslararası bir pazarda çalışmak, Türkiye’den Hızlı karar alan, fikirlerini hayata geçirebileceğin bir ekip [Maaş, yan haklar vb.] Başvururken özgeçmişinin yanına ekle: Almanya’da takviye satan bir markanın reklamlarına bak. Sence hangisi işe yarıyor ve neden? Bizim yerimizde olsan ilk ne yapardın?

review_candidates.title: Directeur financier et comptable
review_candidates.description: Présentation du poste Le Directeur Financier et Comptable est le garant de la régularité et de la sincérité de la gestion financière de la Fédération Malienne de Football. Il dirige la fonction financière, comptable et de contrôle interne, et rend compte aux organes dirigeants de l’usage des ressources de la fédération. Réussir sur ce poste, c’est installer une gouvernance financière lisible et contrôlée : des procédures appliquées, un contrôle interne efficace, des comptes conformes au référentiel OHADA et aux exigences de la CAF et de la FIFA, et des instances qui disposent d’informations fiables pour décider. Rattaché au Secrétaire Général, le poste occupe une position transversale. Il irrigue l’ensemble des directions de la fédération, des achats aux partenariats, et accompagne la montée en professionnalisme de l’institution. Responsabilités Concevoir et faire appliquer le manuel de procédures administratives, financières et comptables, en garantissant la séparation des tâches. Mettre en place et piloter le dispositif de contrôle interne, notamment les circuits de validation, les délégations de pouvoirs et le contrôle des pièces avant paiement. Élaborer le budget annuel et le plan de trésorerie, et en assurer le suivi mensuel. Garantir une comptabilité régulière et sincère, conforme au référentiel OHADA applicable (SYCEBNL), et superviser les clôtures, les rapprochements bancaires et la justification des avances. Établir les états financiers annuels et les présenter au Comité Exécutif et à l’Assemblée Générale. Piloter la trésorerie, la caisse et les relations bancaires, dans le respect des plafonds et de la bancarisation des opérations. Assurer la gestion financière et le reporting des fonds de développement de la CAF et de la FIFA, dont FIFA Forward, dans le respect de leurs exigences d’audit. Suivre les financements et contrats des partenaires, qu’il s’agisse de sponsors, de subventions ou de droits commerciaux, et vérifier la régularité des engagements et des paiements. Assurer le suivi des audits internes et externes et la mise en œuvre de leurs recommandations. Prévenir les risques de fraude et de conflit d’intérêts, et veiller au respect des règles d’éthique et de gouvernance. Encadrer et évaluer l’équipe de la Direction financière, dans une logique de développement des compétences. Produire des tableaux de bord et des rapports financiers réguliers à l’intention de la hiérarchie et des instances. Qualifications Diplôme supérieur de niveau Bac+4/5 en comptabilité, contrôle, audit, finance ou gestion, ou formation équivalente. Dix années minimum d’expérience professionnelle pertinente en finance et comptabilité, dont cinq années à un poste de direction financière ou de responsable financier. Maîtrise du référentiel OHADA (SYCEBNL) et de la fiscalité malienne, ainsi que du contrôle interne, de la gestion budgétaire et de la trésorerie. Bonne connaissance des exigences financières et d’audit de la CAF et de la FIFA. Maîtrise d’un logiciel comptable ou d’un ERP, et des outils de gestion modernes. Certification d’expertise comptable (DSCG, ACCA, CPA ou équivalent) appréciée. Expérience en fédération sportive, institution internationale, ONG ou organisation gérant des fonds de bailleurs, appréciée. Excellente maîtrise du français ; bonne maîtrise de l’anglais appréciée. Leadership, intégrité, rigueur, discrétion, capacité à travailler sous pression et sens de l’initiative.

The Dental Assistant will support dentists and hygienists during clinical procedures, including preparing treatment rooms, arranging instruments, and assisting with chairside tasks. Effective communication skills in English and Arabic, with a professional and empathetic approach to patient interaction. Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced clinical environment, with flexibility to support different providers and schedules.

review_candidates.title: Contract Specialist, Medical Equipment & Supplies
review_candidates.description: Are you a data-driven professional with experience developing reports and dashboards, analyzing performance metrics, and supporting contract, procurement, or vendor management activities? Do you enjoy translating complex information into actionable insights and recommendations that support operational decision-making? If so, take a look at this rewarding career opportunity working alongside a supportive and collaborative team of over 9,000 regulated health care and other professionals. We are amid a momentous time for health care in Ontario as we move to a more connected health care system through the Ontario Health Teams model of care. Ontario Health at Home is looking for four (4) Contract Specialists, Medical Equipment & Supplies (MES) to support the planning, analysis, monitoring, and reporting activities associated with the MES portfolio. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Medical Equipment & Supplies, the Contract Specialist provides provincial analytical, operational and contract management support for Ontario Health atHome's Medical Equipment and Supplies (MES) portfolio. The Contract Specialist translates operational, financial, utilization, inventory, procurement, contract, and vendor performance data into actionable insights that drive provincial standardization, performance management, risk mitigation and continuous improvement. The position supports the development and implementation of consistent provincial reporting, performance measures, dashboards, and analytical methodologies, while identifying trends, service risks, opportunities and impacts across regions, vendors and product categories. Working collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders, the Contract Specialist supports formulary management, vendor performance management, procurement and contract initiatives, inventory optimization, transition and implementation activities, and strategic MES projects. The role helps ensure patients have timely access to safe, high-quality, and cost-effective medical equipment and supplies across Ontario. This position requires the ability to connect quantitative analysis with operational and patient-services impacts and to translate complex information into clear recommendations for management and governance decision-making. What do we offer? We Know Wellness Is Supported With Work-life Balance. In An Inclusive Culture Committed To Support Your Passion For Continuous Learning, Growth And Innovation, We Offer Attractive comprehensive compensation packages and benefits Valuable development opportunities Membership in a world class defined benefit pension plan Salary: $71,194 to $85,010 Flexible work location - can be located at any Ontario Health atHome office, space permitting What will you do? Establish and maintain standardized provincial methodologies, definitions, data sources and reporting processes for MES performance, including vendor service levels, order fulfillment, on-time delivery, out-of-stock recurrences, backorders, inventory and other key performance indicators. Collect, integrate data from multiple sources, validate, analyze, reconcile discrepancies to ensure reporting is accurate, consistent and interpret related to MES utilization, operational, financial, inventory, and vendor performance. Provide regular and ad hoc reporting, analysis, and recommendations to support operational and strategic decision-making. Monitor, develop and maintain vendor scorecards and performance review materials that identify contractual obligations, service standards, key performance indicators, recurring deficiencies, corrective actions and trends requiring intervention or escalation to meet organizational objectives. Conduct root cause and trend analysis of vendor, inventory, procurement and operational performance issues and identify potential financial, service, patient and regional impacts and recommendations for improvement. Support procurement initiatives, including market assessments, Requests for Information (RFIs), Requests for Proposals (RFPs), business case development, and procurement evaluations. Conduct environmental scans, market research, supplier analyses, and benchmarking activities to support procurement and portfolio decisions. Support contract implementation, transition planning, and readiness activities associated with procurement initiatives. Assist in the development and maintenance of the MES formulary, including utilization analysis, product reviews, and formulary recommendations. Prepare presentations, briefing notes, reports, and materials for governance committees, stakeholder meetings, and executive leadership. Support financial forecasting, demand planning, scenario modeling, and budget monitoring activities. Collaborate with internal teams, service providers, vendors, and system partners to support MES initiatives and strategic priorities. Analyze vendor, inventory, procurement and operational performance trends to identify root causes, emerging risks and potential financial, service, patient, and regional impacts, supporting timely mitigation and management action. Provide project coordination and analytical support for key MES initiatives, projects, and working groups. Identify and implement opportunities to automate manual reporting and streamline analytical processes, improving the efficiency, reliability and timeliness of MES information. Serve as a subject matter resource for MES data, reporting and performance information, helping stakeholders interpret results, understand limitations and apply insights to operational and strategic decision-making. What must you have? University degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Health Administration, Health Sciences, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Experience working with reporting and business intelligence tools such as Power BI. Experience developing dashboards, reports, scorecards, and analytical tools. Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with demonstrated ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations. Proven ability to conduct trend analysis and prepare formal written reports. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic and changing environment. Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information in a discreet and professional manner. Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. Excellent verbal and written communication skills and effective interpersonal skills. Strong presentation skills to provide information and education to staff at all levels of the organization and/or external stakeholders. We have a mandatory COVID-19 vaccination policy. As a condition of employment, all employees are required to submit proof of COVID-19 vaccination status prior to start date. What would give you the edge? Professional certification in supply chain, procurement, project management, business analysis, or quality improvement. Minimum three (3) years of experience in healthcare, procurement, supply chain, contract management, business analytics, performance reporting, or a related field. Experience working within Ontario Health atHome, Ontario Health, a healthcare service provider, or broader healthcare sector. Experience working with Client Health and Related Information System (CHRIS), including familiarity with back-end contract structure and script process. Knowledge of healthcare procurement, contract management, inventory management, supplier performance management, and supply chain principles. Who are we? We are Ontario Health atHome, ready to serve every person in Ontario. We partner with patients and caregivers, family physicians, hospitals, long-term care and retirement homes, service providers and Ontario Health Teams, to deliver responsive, accessible, integrated, patient-centered care. Why join us? If you’re interested in driving excellence in care and service delivery , and seeking an unparalleled opportunity to lead and learn, partner and connect, care and be cared for, this is your home. Accommodations for persons with disabilities required during the recruitment process are available upon request. We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted. This job posting is for an existing vacancy.

The company focuses on innovation, safety, and reliability, delivering products and services that support critical missions and improve the passenger and operator experience. Collins Aerospace offers opportunities to work with cutting-edge manufacturing processes and high-precision components used worldwide. Team members benefit from a professional environment that emphasizes continuous improvement, technical excellence, and collaboration across disciplines. Role Description The Computer Numerical Control (CNC) Operator is a full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad. This role involves setting up, operating, and monitoring CNC machines to produce high-precision aerospace components according to engineering specifications and production schedules. Day-to-day tasks include reading and interpreting technical drawings, selecting appropriate tools and materials, performing machine adjustments, and verifying that finished parts meet dimensional and quality standards. The CNC Operator will record production data, perform basic preventive maintenance, and collaborate with engineers, supervisors, and quality teams to resolve machining issues and optimize processes. The role also requires adherence to safety protocols, housekeeping standards, and company policies to maintain a safe and efficient work environment. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Machine Operation skills, including CNC setup, parameter adjustment, and safe equipment handling. Candidates should possess Quality Control skills, including dimensional inspection, use of measuring instruments (calipers, micrometers, gauges), and documentation of results. Candidates should possess Machining skills such as cutting, drilling, turning, and finishing of metal components to tight tolerances. Candidates should possess Milling skills, including operation of CNC milling machines and optimization of cutting paths and feeds. Candidates should possess experience working with industrial Machinery and an understanding of basic machine maintenance and troubleshooting. Relevant technical diploma or certification in Mechanical, Manufacturing, or related field; prior experience as a CNC Operator or machinist in a precision manufacturing environment is preferred. Ability to read engineering drawings, follow work instructions, and use shop math for measurements and tolerances. Strong attention to detail, commitment to safety, and ability to work in a team-oriented, shift-based production environment.

review_candidates.description: Description Pionner dans les technologies infrarouges, HGH Systèmes Infrarouges (plus de 120 personnes) est une référence Internationale de l’optronique dans le secteur du test et métrologie de systèmes optroniques pour des applications de recherche, industrielles ou de défense. Capable de concevoir des produits d’un bout à l’autre de la chaine (de la conception à la fabrication et du matériel au logiciel), HGH n’a cessé de croitre et dispose aujourd’hui de compétences techniques reconnues à l’international puisqu’HGH réalise aujourd’hui plus de 85% de son CA à l’export ! Parmi les différentes familles de produits, HGH Systèmes Infrarouges propose des caméras innovantes haut de gamme (Spynel), des systèmes d’imagerie thermique sans contact pour la Thermographie Industrielle mais également des équipements de tests électro-optique. Présent en France et à l’international (États-Unis, Amérique latine, Asie et Moyen-Orient), le Groupe s’appuie sur son site stratégique d’Igny, en région parisienne, au cœur de la Vallée de l’Optique, où sont réunies ses activités de recherche et développement (R&D) et ses opérations de production. L’ADN d’HGH est simple : des équipes à taille humaine agiles, des produits toujours plus innovants avec un investissement fort en R&D, de nombreuses évolutions de poste boostées par une croissance pérenne. Au quotidien, HGH c’est la convivialité autour de moments de partage tels que des tournois sportifs, son séminaire d’entreprise en Europe, son barbecue estival … Et tout cela dans un bon esprit d’équipe, l’une des valeurs fortes de la Société souvent labellisée HappyIndex®AtWork Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous avons besoin de recruter de nouveaux talents et c’est là que vous intervenez ! Missions Rattaché.e au Responsable d’équipe R&D de notre ligne de produit Spynel : système de veille infrarouge panoramique 360° pour les applications de sécurité et de défense (surveillance de sites sensibles, surveillance de frontières, protection de navires, veille aérienne et anti-drones etc..), vous pilotez des projets internes d’innovation et d’évolution produits ainsi que des projets à destination de clients externes. Vous êtes le.a garant.e du bon déroulement des projets qui vous sont confiés, en particulier vous assurez : La coordination projet de l’équipe d’ingénieurs et d’experts R&D spécialisés en optique, électronique, mécanique, informatique et traitement d’image. La coordination des actions avec les opérations lors des phases de production et de déploiement en lien avec le service support-client. La planification du projet et de ses ressources en lien avec le Responsable d’équipe La gestion des risques techniques L’établissement des revues projet (lancement / conception / validation / fin de projet) La documentation de suivi projet (spécifications, analyse fonctionnelle, matrice de conformité, dossier justificatif de définition, protocoles de validation et de qualification etc.) Le suivi du plan d’action La communication avec les clients internes ou externes Le respect des objectifs de coût / délai de réalisation / performances définis au lancement. Votre expertise système vous permet de comprendre les interfaces entre les différents métiers et sous-ensembles des produits de la gamme afin de participer à l’orientation des choix techniques ou d’architecture en début et en cours de projet. Profil Issu.e d’une formation scientifique/technique de niveau Bac+5 ou équivalent, vous avez nécessairement acquis une première expérience professionnelle d’au moins 3 ans dans la gestion de projet aux interfaces pluridisciplinaires complexes. Votre expertise système vous permet de comprendre les différentes contraintes remontées par les ingénieurs métiers et d’arbitrer / organiser les efforts en vue de l’atteinte des objectifs du projet. Une connaissance de l’optronique infrarouge est un plus. Doté.e d’un bon relationnel, vous êtes capable de vous intégrer dans une équipe expérimentée ainsi que de communiquer avec des clients exigeants. Créatif.ve et engagé.e, vous êtes à l’initiative des actions et solutions de résolution des problèmes techniques, de planning ou autres aléas pouvant apparaitre en cours de projet. Compte tenu de l’environnement international de la société, vous avez un excellent niveau d’anglais. CDI basé à Igny (91) (à 15 mn à pied du RER C Igny, 15min en bus ou vélo du RER B Massy, ou parking à côté de l’entreprise). Possibilité de télétravail jusqu’à 2 jours par semaine Rémunération en fonction du niveau d’expérience (fixe + participation et intéressement significatifs) + mutuelle + tickets restaurant + RTT+ Forfait mobilité durable + avantages CSE. HGH s’engage également dans le respect de la dignité et la diversité de tous en garantissant l’égalité des chances en matière de recrutement et de gestion de carrières (aménagement de poste, temps partiel, etc.)

review_candidates.title: Chargé(e) d'administration RH
review_candidates.company: SGTM (Société Générale des Travaux du Maroc)
review_candidates.description: Société Générale des Travaux du Maroc (SGTM) , acteur majeur et référence nationale du secteur du BTP, renforce ses équipes et recrute un(e) Chargé(e) d'Administration RH (H/F) . Au cœur de nos opérations, vous intégrez une structure dynamique pour garantir une gestion rigoureuse, fluide et de proximité de nos collaborateurs sur l'ensemble de nos projets. Missions Principales Gestion du volet contractuel et administratif : Établir les contrats de travail, avenants et documents réglementaires, et assurer la constitution et le suivi rigoureux des dossiers administratifs du personnel. Onboarding et intégration : Coordonner et réussir le parcours d'intégration des nouveaux collaborateurs dès leur prise de poste. Fiabilisation des bases de données RH : Assurer la tenue à jour, la vérification et l'optimisation continue des données du personnel dans nos systèmes d'information et tableaux de bord. Gestion du quotidien et relais opérationnel : Traiter les demandes administratives courantes des collaborateurs et assurer une interface efficace et fluide entre les services centraux et les différents sites/chantiers. Profil Recherché Formation : BAC+2 (DUT, BTS, EST ou équivalent) en Gestion des Ressources Humaines, Administration des Entreprises ou gestion. Expérience : 3 à 5 ans d'expérience réussie dans la gestion administrative du personnel, idéalement dans le secteur du BTP ou au sein d'une structure multi-sites. Compétences techniques : Maîtrise de la législation du travail et des procédures administratives RH. Excellente maîtrise d'Excel et de l'outil informatique pour la gestion et l'analyse de données. Qualités personnelles : Rigueur, sens aigu de l'organisation, réactivité, discrétion et excellentes qualités relationnelles.

review_candidates.title: CRM Marketing Operations Lead (Enterprise ESP + SQL) w/ $500 Sign-on Bonus! (LATAM, Remote)
review_candidates.description: Who We Are GrowthAssistant connects top marketing and operations talent with fast-growing companies that depend on great execution to scale. Founded in 2021 and named by Forbes as one of the best startups to work at, we’re a permanently remote team that runs on integrity, proactive candor, and a bias toward action — and we prioritize the human experience in everything we do. We hire for skill and for heart, and we invest in our people for the long haul. The Opportunity We’re hiring a CRM Marketing Operations Lead (Enterprise ESP + SQL) to serve as the operational anchor of the CRM and Promotional Operations team at a high-growth consumer technology company — functioning similarly to a Site Reliability Engineer for marketing: owning live campaign monitoring, on-call triage, incident command, and root-cause analysis for post-launch errors, while also managing a team of 4+ QA specialists and enforcing the operational standards that keep high-visibility, budget-critical campaigns from going wrong. Your time will be split approximately 50% team leadership and escalation management, and 50% hands-on advanced technical QA — this is not a traditional pre-launch QA role. It requires someone who is highly autonomous, technically rigorous, comfortable holding a distributed team accountable, and decisive under pressure when production issues arise. What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like Team Leadership & Accountability: Manage daily operations and serve as the primary escalation point for a team of 4+ QA specialists — leading daily stand-ups to assess workloads, reallocate tickets, and manage expedited requests; enforcing strict SLAs, task accountability, and end-of-shift status reporting; and taking decisive management action when expectations are missed. Production Support & Incident Management: Monitor live production campaigns and act as incident commander for on-call triage and rapid resolution; conduct root-cause analyses on post-launch errors and communicate findings and remediation plans to cross-functional partners and leadership; and serve as the final gatekeeper for urgent, high-visibility, or C-suite-directed campaign requests to mitigate financial risk. Technical Operations & Advanced QA: Audit, update, and schedule complex digital campaigns across email, push notifications, in-app messaging, and promo code engines; use SQL to verify target audience sizes against promotional logic and validate that large-scale marketing budgets align with business guardrails; and deep-dive into campaign assets to validate HTML/CSS, copy accuracy, and advanced dynamic targeting strategies. Process Optimization & AI Enablement: Maintain and optimize QA checklists to incorporate new product features and marketing surfaces; analyze error trends to build targeted training documentation; leverage AI and automation tools to accelerate triage and live-campaign monitoring; and champion AI adoption across the team by coaching team members on integrating these tools into daily workflows. What You Bring CRM & Production Support Experience: 3+ years in technical operations, production support, or advanced QA within CRM ecosystems — with 3+ years of hands-on technical experience inside enterprise-level ESP/CRM platforms; Braze experience is highly preferred. People Management: 2+ years of formal or informal people management experience with a proven track record of enforcing accountability, managing performance, and building trust with a distributed team. Technical Proficiency: Intermediate to advanced SQL proficiency required for audience validation; working knowledge of HTML/CSS for campaign asset validation; strong Google Sheets and/or Excel skills for operational workflows. Financial & Promotional Guardrail Experience: Direct experience auditing promotional budgets or managing campaigns with high monetary impact — with the judgment and decisiveness to act as the final gatekeeper under time pressure. Communication & Leadership Presence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; comfortable delivering clear status updates to executive leadership and holding firm on quality standards with execution teams simultaneously. Bonus Points if: You have prior experience in the tech sector, high-growth startups, or supporting app-centric digital products. You have familiarity with Agile or Scrum methodologies and ticketing systems such as Jira or Asana. Sign-on Bonus: $500 bonus upon successful completion of the first 90 days of employment What We Offer At GrowthAssistant, you aren’t just joining a company; you’re joining a movement to redefine how the world’s best brands scale. We believe that the right talent, placed in the right role, changes everything — and that starts with how we take care of you. We support your life inside and outside of work with a comprehensive benefits package: Fully Remote: 100% Remote work environment, never fight traffic again Health Coverage: HMO (depending on location) after 90 days of service Time to Recharge: 7 Paid Holidays and up to 6 PTO days per year Family First: Parental leave after 1 year of service We offer additional incentives for go-getters and proven performers! Anniversary bonus ($100 at 1 year; $200 at 2 years) Earn a $300 referral bonus for each candidate you refer who is successfully hired, and $500 when you help us identify and close a new opportunity with your client Your Application Roadmap You’ve applied, now let’s get to work. Here’s the play-by-play: Step 1 Resume Screening: Our hiring team reviews your experience to see how your unique skills align with our high-growth roles. Step 2 Recruiter Interview: If we believe we have a great client match, we’ll reach out to schedule a human-to-human chat to discuss your career goals, experience, and what makes you tick. Step 3 Online Assessment: This is your chance to shine! You’ll complete a role-specific test, a personality assessment, and your official GA Profile Form so we can represent you. Step 4 Match Interview: You’ll meet with one of our Senior Leaders for a deep-dive validation to ensure we’re matching you with the right opportunity. This is your moment to bring your A-game and really shine — it’s the final step for many of our roles! Depending on the client, there are sometimes 2 additional steps: Step 5 15-min Prep Call: We’ve got your back. Before the final round, your Recruiter will hop on a quick call to coach you, share insider tips, and ensure you’re 100% ready. Step 6 Client Interview: You’ll meet the client to discuss how you’ll help them scale and succeed. Bring your metrics and be on your A-game — this is your last chance to make a great first impression! Join our 100% remote global team today, and grow with GrowthAssistant! GrowthAssistant is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

review_candidates.title: CNA - Nights - Hospice IPU
review_candidates.description: Explore opportunities with Baptist Trinity Hospice, a part of LHC Group . As part of the Optum family of businesses, we provide home health, hospice and community-based services that help people receive quality care where they feel most comfortable: at home. Rooted in personalized care, we support patients and provide comfort through each stage of their health journey, while building trusted relationships along the way. Find a home for your career here. Join us and embrace a culture of Caring. Connecting. Growing together. Schedule is Nights - 7:00pm-7:00am As the Inpatient Unit C.N.A., you will provide support, assistance with personal hygiene and household functions for an individual to be able to remain in their own home. Primary Responsibilities Provide personal care and assist with daily living activities such as bathing, grooming, dressing, ambulation, and medication reminders Support meal preparation, and accompany clients to appointments or errands as needed Monitor and document client condition, vital signs, and incidents; maintain confidentiality and use EVV system Ensure a safe environment, operate medical equipment properly, and respond promptly to client needs Ability to function in any situation regardless of age, race, creed, color, sex, disability, or financial condition of the client You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in. Required Qualification Current driver's license, vehicle insurance, and reliable transportation or access to public transportation State-Specific Requirements Category I and II- Home Health Aide- Medicare Certified Home Health Provider TN: Successful completion of a total of seventy-five (75) hours of training which include sixteen (16) hours of clinical training prior to or during the first three (3) months of employment and who is qualified to provide basic services, including simple procedures as extension of therapy services, personal care regarding nutritional needs, ambulation and exercise, and household services essential to health care at home. Preferred Qualifications Current CPR certification or ability to complete within 90 days of hire 6+ months of home care experience Ability to work flexible hours and independently Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The hourly pay for this role will range from $14.00 to $23.85 per hour based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable. At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and help make the health system work better for everyone. Together, we are shaping the future of healthcare by harnessing technology and innovation to make care simpler to navigate, more affordable and more connected for the people we serve. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcomed, valued, heard and respected, empowering people to bring their authentic selves to work and strengthening our collective impact through diverse talents, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. UnitedHealth Group and its affiliated brands are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer under applicable law and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations. UnitedHealth Group and its affiliated brands are a drug-free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment.
